finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified.

## Final Report

**1. DONE** — Ticket `fwrd49-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created as **RD-1015** (customer "Bench Test Co", created 2026-09-12), initially in status **Draft**.

**2. DONE** — Part `fwrd49-n1 RD Part A` added with cost **$100.00** and markup **25%** (qty 1). The app computed a price of **$125.00**.

**3. DONE** — Part `fwrd49-n1 RD Part B` added with cost **$200.00** and markup **25%** (qty 1). The app computed a price of **$250.00**. Parts table footer total at that point: $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to **150** (markup unchanged at 25%). The app then computed a price of **$187.50** (footer total $437.50).

**5. DONE** — Ticket RD-1015 reached status **Ready**. The app's enforced precondition, discovered by probing with a separate throwaway ticket (`fwrd49-n1 RD Probe`, RD-1016) that had no parts: attempting "Mark Ready" with zero parts was refused with the verbatim error **"Ticket is not ready / A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"**. So the exact requirement is **at least one part on the ticket**. RD-1015 already had two parts, so its "Mark Ready" click was accepted immediately with no error, and the status persisted as Ready across a full page reload. (The probe ticket was itself archived afterwards so it left nothing active.)

**6. DONE** — Both parts were removed (each delete opened a Confirm dialog with "Delete part", which I accepted; the app did not refuse deletion while the ticket was Ready, so no status change back to Draft was needed). Final parts count: **0** ("No parts on this ticket yet."). The ticket was then archived: the detail page shows **Status: Ready / Archived** with an "Unarchive ticket" button, and the tickets list (with "Show archived" ticked) shows `RD-1015 | fwrd49-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Test Co | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-12`. Verified that with "Show archived" unticked neither RD-1015 nor RD-1016 appears — no active ticket created by this run remains.
